_note: Drift Guard 6 (PAPER-WEIGHT). Two CI checks in scripts/check-paper-weight.js plus the auto-archive job in scripts/archive-backlog.js. (1) SIZE CAP: BACKLOG.md may not exceed backlog_max_lines — a shrink-only ratchet: LOWER it in the same PR that trims/archives the file; RAISING it needs a recorded justification. (2) STALENESS: CI fails when an item explicitly tagged [archive-ready: YYYY-MM-DD] lingers more than stale_after_days (default 7) past that date. The tag is the ONLY archival signal — the guard never guesses from a free-text ✅ / 'shipped' / 'FIXED', because the 2026-07-20 reconciliation (docs/verification/BACKLOG_RECONCILIATION_2026-07-20.md) proved a heuristic cannot safely tell a fully-shipped item from a ✅-with-open-follow-up one, so the staleness rule can never false-fail the many kept ✅-with-follow-up items. Clear a staleness failure with `npm run archive:backlog -- --apply`, which moves the tagged items (bullet + indented children) to BACKLOG_ARCHIVE.md and ratchets this cap down. The deeper split-a-shipped-item's-prose-from-its-open-follow-up editorial pass stays deferred as owner-visible judgment work (BACKLOG.md's [housekeeping] 'Deeper BACKLOG re-section' item).
